Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Fe centers eight neighbors (4 As, 4 Ho), As centers ten neighbors (6 Fe, 4 Ho), and Ho centers eight As neighbors, all with distances near 2.78–3.48 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Fe 8-vertex polyhedra and As 10-vertex polyhedra, plus corner and face sharing between As polyhedra.
